title: Budget Left Before Next Birthday Cluster
dataSources: Shared calendar events (`sharedcalendar:event`), gift budget items (`giftbudget:item`), touchpoint logs (`touchpoint:log`), and relationship rituals (`relationship:ritual`).
app: Relationship and togetherness telemetry from shared calendars, gift budgets, message and call logs, and long-distance touchpoint trackers sent to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=giftbudget:item
| search occasion_type="birthday"
| stats latest(budget_remaining) as budget_remaining count as recipients by month
| sort 0 - budget_remaining
description: Ranks monthss by budget remaining before birthday clusters.
value: Birthday clusters are when the gift budget gets tested hardest, so the remaining buffer matters.
implementation: Send budget remaining before birthday clusters events to `index=personal` and keep `month` populated so the leaderboard stays actionable.
visualization: Bar chart of budget remaining before birthday clusters by months.
grandmaExplanation: It frames which monthss stand out most for budget remaining before birthday clusters.
